QuestInfo.name: Black Wings Hat 2
QuestInfo.0: What does #b#p2153000##k have to say? Go find out.
QuestInfo.1: #p2153000#, one of the Black Wing managers, says he'll give you his #b#t1003134##k. With his hat, the gatekeepers will surely let you in. All you have to do is give him the dough--#b10 #t4000604#s#k items, to be specific. Defeat the #rPatrol Robot S#k enemies nearby to get the #t4000604#s.
QuestInfo.2: You got the #t1003134#. Wasn't difficult, just expensive. Bring it to Veritas.

0.0: As you can see by my uniform, I am a distinguished member of the Black Wings. If you were to purchase my hat, you might have a slim chance of slipping by our security measures.
0.1: Obviously there would be a rather hefty fee. The #b#t1003134##k is a symbol of our clandestine organization. Get me the #b#t4000604#s#k, and I'll hand it over.
0.2: And I will certainly not miss a thing so simple and... free. Do not concern yourself with my business. A man must make ends meet, especially one with such refined tastes as myself.

yes.0: The price is #b10 #t4000604#s#k. There will be no negotiations. Besides, there are tons of those #rPatrol Robot S# units around. You may return and speak to me when you have my payment.

no.0: Do not waste my time. If you are not serious, I will find someone who is.

1.0: Did you bring the #b#t4000604#s#k? Hand them over and let us be done with this.

yes.0: Put on the hat and you may make it into the mines. Though, in the end, I could not care less whether or not you succeed. Never speak of this to anyone.
yes.1: If you lose that, which I am sure you will somehow manage to do, you may return to me in secret. I would be glad to take some more of your money. Hehehe...

default.0: If you do not have #b10 #t4000604#s#k, you are wasting my valuable time.
